environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) running as root user. Service is directly exposed on port 8080 via a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with no additional request inspection. The /var/app/extracted directory is on the root filesystem with no mount namespace isolation. No AppArmor or SELinux enforcement (permissive mode). The service binary has CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE capability.

config.filesystem: ext4, root partition, no separate mount for /var/app
